analysis.interval: exact binomial/order-statistic median interval, at least 95% coverage
analysis.assumption: independent continuous paired ratios; serial host effects can violate independence
analysis.pass: median >= 1.00 and exact interval lower bound >= 0.98
analysis.otherwise: inconclusive; uncertainty is not evidence of parity
analysis.scope: local engineering tolerances, not production SLOs

analysis_revision: Revalidated unchanged raw runs with finite/positive/rounding checks and exact median interval. The original small-n bootstrap interval was exploratory and its nominal 95% label overstated coverage; retained in results-as-run.json and driver-as-run.py. Independent review requested this correction before the final results were analyzed.
